# Reader Sticky Pinch Continuation Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development. Controller alone mutates checkouts and dispatches tests; workers write only designated proposals/reports. Checkboxes describe execution after user approval.

**Status:** Proposed. This document does not authorize source edits, setup, simulator allocation, builds, or tests.
**Goal:** Resolve the missing native sticky-detent evidence with one evidence-supported test-input correction, then finish the six-case Pro Max verification.
**Architecture:** Preserve the actual Reader integration and sticky policy. Add bounded DEBUG-only native gesture tracing, distinguish insufficient accepted input from a product failure, and change only the test stimulus when justified.
**Tech stack:** Swift, SwiftUI/UIKit, existing Swift package tests, XCTest, dedicated iOS 18.6 simulators.

## Global constraints and evidence decision

- Persistence investigation remains PARKED. No ReaderViewModel, repositories, schema, stores, autosave, progress-safety work, Reader redesign, or historical persistence review.
- Sticky contract remains scale .75–3, snap entry 1.03, breakthrough ratio .88, native focal/reset error <=2pt, eleven reset observations spanning >1second, existing container/loading bounds, fresh native gestures, and consumed-gesture chrome checks. No relaxed thresholds, omitted assertions, or synthetic direct-policy injection as native evidence.
- iOS 17 API/deployment floor remains required; iOS 17 runtime remains waived. Package macOS 14 floor remains.
- No reset, clean, stash, checkout reuse, artifact deletion, push, PR, merge, or protected screenshot payload access.
- Prior attempt stays closed, including its uncommitted implementation. Its budget is not renewed. This is a separately approved attempt with fresh bindings.
- Completed stage/final reviews and final pins are the starting basis, not a new historical review. Old native attempts retain 5 passing and 8 failed device-case executions; Pro Max is missing.
- Final inward input registered a fresh gesture but ended at 1.102433268132647, pinchHeld=false. That exceeds the policy's 1.03 snap-entry value. This suggests insufficient accepted contraction, but does not prove XCTest calibration rather than a product defect.
- Existing five passing 16e cases may be carried forward as bounded evidence only while production behavior and those five tests/common launch remain unchanged and final source/behavior bindings are independently verified. They remain results of a failed full run, not a passing suite.
- The earlier full package passed 743 before metadata correction; final focused 11 passed afterward. This attempt runs the full package once on the final package-source bytes.
- Acceptance is scoped Reader zoom evidence, not production/persistence safety or historical native inequality resolution.

## Selected approach and alternatives

Recommend observation-first, test-harness-only continuation. Blind numeric adjustment cannot distinguish missing input from wrong behavior. A product-policy change would require broader 16e regression coverage and a larger authorization; it is excluded here.

The sole calibration candidate is requested inward scale 0.50, replacing 0.54 only if the observed trace supports insufficient contraction from known 2x and predicts crossing snap entry without consuming the additional .88 breakthrough distance. This is a hypothesis, not an accepted result. No parameter sweep or second candidate is authorized. Keep the independent 0.35 breakthrough gesture and all original outcomes.

## Exact allocation

- Before any runtime: verify capacity for controller + one proposal implementer + distinct stage and final reviewers. Reuse suitable idle roles; no simultaneous source writers.
- Two package invocations maximum: focused existing 11 zoom/state/contracts/range/metadata tests once, then full package once, both jobs=1. No unrelated UI suites.
- Runtime: 25 nonrenewable wall-clock minutes from the first package/build/test dispatch, whichever comes first. Both package commands and all native commands share this one timer. Stop new source/runtime at minute20; final5 minutes reserved for stopping/retention. Every dispatched runtime command must finish or be stopped by minute20. Evidence-only retention/reviews may finish afterward; no late tests.
- At most TWO build-for-testing dispatches, THREE UI dispatches, EIGHT device-case executions:
  1. instrumented observation: one existing pinch case on 16e;
  2. final acceptance: same one pinch case on 16e;
  3. final acceptance: existing six-case suite on Pro Max.
- No reruns, parameter search, additional device, extra case, or budget renewal. Any launched case counts even if preconditions or infrastructure fail.
- The observation may fail the known detent assertion and still pass its evidence-collection checkpoint only when all other assertions pass and complete, current native trace establishes the precise missing input. Any different failure stops. It never counts as passing acceptance.
- If observation passes unchanged, make no calibration change: run the separate focused acceptance on the same immutable products, then Pro Max. No second build is needed. Report the earlier failure as not reproduced, without asserting that its cause was proved or fixed.
- Once final 16e acceptance fails, stop before Pro Max. Once Pro Max fails, stop; no correction remains.

## Task 1 — preserve/import and prepare observable native input

**Files:** exactly the fourteen files listed by S's source-pins-final.json are imported to matching W-relative paths. Subsequent amendments are limited to:
- W/app/Sources/ToonEdgeAppCore/Features/Reader/Presentation/ReaderSurfaceViewController.swift: DEBUG-only, doubly launch-gated trace collection.
- W/app/ToonEdgeUITests/ToonEdgeReaderIntegratedZoomUITests.swift: owned trace attachment and, conditionally, one detent input literal.
- New E/proposals/, E/reviews/, commands/results/progress/privacy records only.

**Interfaces:** existing UIPinchGestureRecognizer handler consumes recognizer state/scale/location and ReaderZoomState; existing diagnostic snapshot supplies test data. No persistence or policy interface change.

- [ ] Verify approval, old closure/pins, current origin/main, agent capacity, fresh destinations, parent and device availability before allocating output/runtime.
- [ ] Controller imports dependency and fourteen files; validate full envelopes, preimage bytes, exact absolute destinations, absence/symlink guards, applied bytes/hashes. Each setup action and source application has a separate actual completion gate.
- [ ] Implementer writes complete trace/test proposal under E/proposals/; stage reviewer independently approves scope and full bytes before controller applies.
- [ ] Trace only when DEBUG and both existing -uiTesting and -readerIntegratedZoomFixture gates hold. Record a per-gesture identity, began/changed/ended/cancelled states, actual recognizer magnification, native location and viewport, pre/post presentation scale, isPinching and focal availability. Record enough to identify rejected out-of-bounds samples and accepted contraction; never infer accepted input from requested XCTest scale alone.
- [ ] Bound to four gestures and 512 samples per gesture with explicit overflow/truncation flags. Overflow, missing lifecycle, missing known-2x start, stale ID or incomplete samples makes diagnosis inconclusive and stops; never silently drop evidence.
- [ ] Attach the owned numeric trace from the pinch case and its exclusive helper to XCTest with keep-always retention even on failure. No changes to the other five cases/common launch or global teardown. No URLs, artwork, screenshots or external traffic added. Trace cannot call gesture/state mutations or change gesture scheduling/thresholds.
- [ ] Preserve other five tests and common launch helpers byte-for-byte. Run focused eleven, then full package once after final package-source modifications. Expected exit0; record actual counts rather than assuming 745.
- [ ] Build1, inspect actual exit, stage and archive exact products; dispatch observation with original 0.54 detent request and original assertions.

## Task 2 — causal gate and one conditional stimulus correction

**Files:** same native test file only for correction; native DEBUG recorder remains identical between builds.
**Produces:** an evidence-backed calibration decision and final test envelope, not a changed sticky policy.

- [ ] Independent stage reviewer reads complete trace and failing assertion. Require fresh native input from known2x, inward points within the permitted viewport, complete accepted-sample sequence, no cancel/identity/geometry replacement, and no unrelated failures.
- [ ] Trace must support that accepted contraction never reached the unchanged 1.03 snap threshold. If input crossed the threshold but the expected state was absent, sampling is ambiguous, or the trace indicates controller/policy defects, STOP and report the product issue. No production correction is authorized here.
- [ ] If insufficient input is supported, write the raw trace, calculation and uncertainty to E/diagnosis.md. The single allowed candidate is 0.50; reject it without dispatch if the trace cannot support a detent entry without breakthrough. Do not modify .88, 1.03, velocities, outcome predicates or tolerances as additional variables.
- [ ] Independently review the complete test-only correction before controller applies. Preserve the 0.35 breakthrough, new gesture IDs/sample checks, release retention, pan, chrome checks, reset <=2pt and eleven observations >1s.
- [ ] Build2 only if test source changed. Verify the main app bundle bytes equal build1 and only the detent input/test trace attachment differences exist. Prove all production behavior sources match imported pins; controller recorder differences must be exclusively DEBUG observation.
- [ ] Dispatch final one-case 16e acceptance. Require exit0 and every original assertion. A failed/inconclusive gate stops; no third build or corrective rerun.

## Task 3 — Pro Max acceptance and closure

**Files:** E reports only after final source envelope.

- [ ] On focused16e pass, dispatch the unchanged six-case suite on Pro Max using the same final immutable product set. This is case allocation6, not permission to add miscellaneous tests.
- [ ] Require all six pass: physical pinch/detent/breakthrough/pan/reset; taps/chrome/Original Page; long/short containers/loading; delayed decoded metadata/retry; viewport/fit/spacing anchors; chapter/pipeline replacement/stale restore.
- [ ] Independently bind the five historical16e passes to unchanged production behavior and unchanged test/common-launch bytes. Do not demand final app binary equality to the old app after adding DEBUG recorder; prove complete source diff excludes behavior changes, then require app byte equality between this attempt's builds.
- [ ] Independent final reviewer distinct from implementer checks the whole amendment, actual logs/results, precise device/case accounting, original/fresh source pins, recorder noninterference and native traces. A static or runtime blocker prevents acceptance.
- [ ] Inspect every result bundle's attachment manifest, decode and scan attachment text/plists, inspect owned media with qualified full-duration sampling, retain exact commands/exits/UTC/hashes/progress and product archives. Exclude protected screenshots entirely.
- [ ] Close runtime allocation durably, verify all stopped checkout bindings/evidence unchanged, and record both old and new failures without relabeling.
- [ ] Only after all scoped gates pass, controller may make one local reviewable integration commit in W. No push, PR, merge, cleanup or broader release clearance. If blocked, preserve W unchanged at the stop and report the remaining gate.

## Exact runtime command forms

Here W, E and O denote the absolute bindings above; controller expands them to exact argv arrays and preserves those arrays before dispatch. N is build1 or2, D is exactly one listed device ID, R is the corresponding unique result bundle, and X is the verified immutable internal .xctestrun path.

```sh
xcrun swift test --package-path "$W/app" --scratch-path "$O/SwiftPM" --jobs 1 --filter 'ReaderZoomStateTests|ReaderSurfaceContractTests|ReaderVisibleRangePipelineTests|ReaderEffectivePageMetadataTests'
xcrun swift test --package-path "$W/app" --scratch-path "$O/SwiftPM" --jobs 1
xcodebuild build-for-testing -project "$W/app/ToonEdge.xcodeproj" -scheme ToonEdge -configuration Debug -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,arch=arm64,id=4582CDE9-27DB-4669-86AC-0631C1D7F2ED" -derivedDataPath "$O/DerivedData" -resultBundlePath "$O/build-$N.xcresult" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
xcodebuild test-without-building -xctestrun "$X" -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,arch=arm64,id=$D" -derivedDataPath "$O/DerivedData" -resultBundlePath "$R" -parallel-testing-enabled NO -maximum-concurrent-test-simulator-destinations 1 -only-testing:ToonEdgeUITests/ToonEdgeReaderIntegratedZoomUITests/testPinchStickyReleasePanAndMeasuredReset -collect-test-diagnostics never -test-timeouts-enabled YES -default-test-execution-time-allowance 120 -maximum-test-execution-time-allowance 150
```

For Pro Max only, the only-testing value is the class without the method suffix. No test selection fallback. Full logs and actual process exits are required; shell set-e is not a cross-call gate. At cutoff, stop only the controller-owned process group, record interruption as failure, and retain partial outputs.

## Approval and stops

One approval covers this evidence-basis decision, fresh bindings, observation-only diagnostic exception, one conditional 0.50 test-input correction, exact budget and scoped acceptance. It does not accept the hypothesis in advance.

Stop on changed approved/source pins, changed main, destination collision, prerequisite/capacity/device/storage failure, evidence-preservation/privacy failure, trace ambiguity/overflow, different observation failure, evidence of a production defect, unsupported 0.50 candidate, failed final16e/ProMax gate, reviewer blocker, any broader code need or exhausted time/dispatch allocation. Preserve everything. No further authority is inferred.

Preparation performed only read-only inspection and this proposal write. No stopped checkout, build product, simulator, source or test was modified or dispatched.
